blocks.text: VIGAN CITY — “I can’t calm myself.” That was Dianne Tacazon Tolentino’s reaction after learning that she had topped the August-September 2026 Philippine Nurses Licensure Examination (PNLE)—a dream she had long held and now sees as manifested. The achievement brought pride to her home province of Ilocos Sur, as Tolentino, a magna cum laude graduate of the University of Northern Philippines (UNP)-Vigan, emerged as the country’s No. 1 nursing board passer with a rating of 92.20 percent. The Heritage Province of Ilocos Sur celebrated Tolentino’s feat, hailing her as an outstanding nursing topnotcher and a source of pride for the province. […]...
